brief.question: Rebuild the Android app swss.apk (space.xinzhi.globe, "三维山水全景地图", a Feng Shui 3D landscape compass/map) as a functionally identical desktop app.
brief.purpose: The person wants a desktop equivalent of a Feng Shui compass app, with the build/debug environment and dependencies in local Docker and source on the host.
constraints: Docker for build/deps, source on host
brief.done_when: A Rust/egui desktop app builds and runs with --screenshot producing a non-blank PNG, showing the Feng Shui compass (24 mountains, three plates, divisions) and knowledge base; Docker build files provided; mechanics.json and MECHANICS.md recorded.

handoff: DONE. Rebuilt swss.apk (space.xinzhi.globe, "三维山水全景地图", a Feng Shui 罗盘 app) as a Rust+eframe/egui desktop app in app/. Interactive eframe compass (three 24-mountain plates colored by 五行, 120分金/72龙/60龙 rings, 八卦, heading reading panel, knowledge base) + windowless software renderer for --screenshot (headless-safe, in src/software.rs). mechanics.json (15 sourced values) + MECHANICS.md (per-mountain 五行/分金/龙 tables marked estimated — DEX is packed). rebuild_check PASSES (build, 1100x780 screenshot, mechanics). Docker env VERIFIED: `docker compose build` (rust:1.90-slim) + `cargo build` in container succeed (Linux). Traps: rebuild_check is headless so --screenshot must not open a window; `docker compose run` alone reuses the stale image — run `docker compose build` after Dockerfile changes. Scratch left in .inspect/.
